messages.subject: shinyapps.io error
parts:
I just performed my first upload of a Shiny app to shinyapps.io (free version). It works fine locally in RStudio (updated versions of RS, Shiny, leaflet), but uploaded yields the following error:

ERROR: could not find function "leafletOutput"

What could be missing?

messages.author: a5482f8ad67b92c7
messages.subject: Re: shinyapps.io error
parts: What was missing was that the leaflet package, though loaded in server.R, was not loaded in ui.R
